items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: There's a play a friend of mine did, named Dan Wolfe.

ctx.x: That's why I say, if that were the case, if the play had word of mouth, let's say, or a record, that word of mouth if it was good word of mouth would get around and you'd have people buying the thing before they knew that they weren't supposed to like it.

That's right, and why should the Times carry that much power, with one man to walk in and destroy a play? There's a play a friend of mine did, named Dan Wolfe. The critics just destroyed him in one night. And most of them didn't come.
